nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Nexscope Ozon product report search: filters Ozon products by multi-dimensional metrics including sales, revenue, sales/revenue growth rate, cart conversion rate, order conversion rate, price, rating, review count, QA count, variant count, page views, gross margin, return/cancellation rate, ad spend share, weight/volume, listing time, brand, seller, fulfillment method, and labels. Returns each product's SKU, title, price (RUB), sales, revenue, lost revenue, conversion rate, rating, reviews, brand, seller, fulfillment method, listing days/months, and complete product report fields. Use for Ozon product selection, competitor product analysis, best-seller mining, price/conversion band filtering. Trigger when the user mentions Ozon product report, Ozon product selection, Ozon product filtering, Ozon product analysis, Ozon best-selling products, Ozon competitor product analysis, Ozon product report, Ozon product screener, filter Ozon products by sales, Ozon best-seller mining, Nexscope Ozon product report. Also trigger when the intent is to filter Ozon products by multiple metrics and view product-level reports, even without explicitly mentioning Nexscope.

brand.description: Brand filter: {brandName: array<string>, type: integer}; type takes 0 include brand, 1 exclude brand, 2 unbranded

categoryIds.description: Category ID array (Nexscope category IDs, not category names)

convToCartPdp.description: Cart conversion-rate range: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

creationDate.description: Listing time filter (months), fixed options: 1 last 30 days, 3 last 90 days, 6 last 180 days, 12 last year, 24 last two years; no filtering if omitted

drr.description: Advertising cost-share range: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

fulfillment.description: Fulfillment method array, fixed options: OZON, FBO, FBS, RFBS, FBP

grossMargin.description: Gross-margin range: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

keywords.description: Keyword array, filters by product title

labels.description: Label array, fixed options: 0 new product, 1 genuine product, 2 best seller

memberId.description: Member ID (a unique member identifier; data is attributed to memberId)

monthlyRevenue.description: Monthly revenue range in RUB: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

monthlySales.description: Monthly sales range: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

monthlySalesRate.description: Sales growth-rate range: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

page.description: Nonempty pagination and sorting object: {page, pageSize, orders[]}. Omitted nested defaults are not inserted. Ranges accept optional finite bounds and require min <= max; numeric strings and optional null remain backend compatibility extensions.

page.orders.description: Sort rules, elements {field, direction}; direction takes DESC (descending) / ASC (ascending). field is a metric field in the response (e.g., sales, revenue, price, reviewRating, reviewCount, salesRate)

price.description: Price range in RUB: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

questionsAndAnswers.description: Question-and-answer count range: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

returnCancellationRate.description: Return and cancellation-rate range: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

reviewCount.description: Review-count range: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

reviewRating.description: Rating range from 0 to 5: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

searchDate.description: Query date yyyy-MM-dd. Omit for a rolling last-30-days period; provide a date to query the preceding complete historical month (2026-04-01 selects March 2026), not month-to-date.

skus.description: SKU array (max 10), for precise lookup of specified products

variants.description: Variant-count range: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted

variationsMerge.description: Whether to merge variants: 0 do not merge, 1 merge

volume.description: Volume range in liters: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted. The supplier does not specify whether this measures the item or parcel.

weight.description: Weight range in grams: {min, max}; either bound may be omitted. The supplier does not specify whether packaging is included.
